notes: «- يعني الحمصي -» is an editor's gloss: left out.
«بهذا الحديث بإسناده لم يذكر الصلاة» is a version of the same chain that omits the prayer: its wording is left out, and only the back_reference «بإسناده» is kept as the route's end.
The chain as written ends at محمد بن مسلم; no Companion is named in the text.

fixes.reason: K6I's sequence adds two Companions after محمد بن مسلم which the text does not name.

evidence.quote: عباد بن تميم بن غزية الأنصاري
